title: Excellent Air Purifier
text: Excellent Air Purifier. As a mother with several children with allergy problems, I am no stranger to using air filters/purifiers in my home/various rooms. The Fellowes purifier with Hepa does an excellent job. It is solid and runs almost silently. I was amazed at how much dust and allergens were collected in just one week of use. I highly recommend this purifier to anyone who is looking to change their room into a cleaner, easier to breath place to be. Of course, it is only good for a normal size room so you will need more of these if you plan to convert your whole home into an allergen free room. I am using it in my oldest son's room and I can tell you that, without a doubt, the Fellowes is an excellent little machine. Kudos!
